g.text: EN stays under 2 V at a 28 V input (EN absolute maximum is VIN + 0.3 V).

g.desc: EN stays under 2 V at a 28 V input (EN absolute maximum is VIN + 0.3 V).

g.text: L1 6.8 uH at 800 kHz gives about 0.5 A ripple at 26.4 V in (datasheet Eq 10 K about 0.5), above the 1.03 uH minimum of Eq 11 (0.25 x 3.3 V / 800 kHz); 3x 22 uF is unverified: Table 9-1 has no 3.3 V row.

g.desc: L1 6.8 uH at 800 kHz gives about 0.5 A ripple at 26.4 V in (datasheet Eq 10 K about 0.5), above the 1.03 uH minimum of Eq 11 (0.25 x 3.3 V / 800 kHz); 3x 22 uF is unverified: Table 9-1 has no 3.3 V row.

g.text: LMR38010SDDAR: internal compensation, exposed pad (pin 9) on GND, open-drain PG, PFM with spread spectrum.

g.desc: LMR38010SDDAR: internal compensation, exposed pad (pin 9) on GND, open-drain PG, PFM with spread spectrum.

g.text: C1 bulk, C2 ceramic, C3 high-frequency next to the VIN pin (LMR38010 section 9.2.2.6: at least 4.7 uF + 100 to 220 nF).

g.desc: C1 bulk, C2 ceramic, C3 high-frequency next to the VIN pin (LMR38010 section 9.2.2.6: at least 4.7 uF + 100 to 220 nF).

g.text: D2 TVS (30 V standoff) sits after D1, directly on the VIN node. Its 48.4 V clamp is below U1's 85 V absolute maximum, so U1 stays within its rating under a surge the TVS can absorb.

g.desc: D2 TVS (30 V standoff) sits after D1, directly on the VIN node. Its 48.4 V clamp is below U1's 85 V absolute maximum, so U1 stays within its rating under a surge the TVS can absorb.

g.text: R_RT 33k from RT/SYNC to GND sets 800 kHz (RT table under datasheet Figure 8-4); the pin must not float.

g.desc: R_RT 33k from RT/SYNC to GND sets 800 kHz (RT table under datasheet Figure 8-4); the pin must not float.

g.text: Divider taps the output node on the far side of L1, not SW.

g.desc: Divider taps the output node on the far side of L1, not SW.

g.text: C4 100 nF boot capacitor between BOOT and SW.

g.desc: C4 100 nF boot capacitor between BOOT and SW.

g.text: 50 V parts for a 24 V rail; DC-bias derating of C2 is not known.

g.desc: 50 V parts for a 24 V rail; DC-bias derating of C2 is not known.

g.text: The exposed pad (pin 9) is soldered to the F.Cu GND pour. There are no vias in the pad:

g.desc: The exposed pad (pin 9) is soldered to the F.Cu GND pour. There are no vias in the pad:

g.text: the board's fabrication floor is a 0.3 mm drill and the KiCad thermal-via footprint ships 0.2 mm.

g.desc: the board's fabrication floor is a 0.3 mm drill and the KiCad thermal-via footprint ships 0.2 mm.

g.text: EN divider from VIN. LMR38010 VEN-H 1.25 V typical (1.1 to 1.4), VEN-L 1.10 V typical: start 18.4 V (16.2 to 20.6 V), stop 16.2 V.

g.desc: EN divider from VIN. LMR38010 VEN-H 1.25 V typical (1.1 to 1.4), VEN-L 1.10 V typical: start 18.4 V (16.2 to 20.6 V), stop 16.2 V.

g.text: J1 pin 1 is +24 V, pin 2 is GND.

g.desc: J1 pin 1 is +24 V, pin 2 is GND.

g.text: Two M2.5 non-plated holes in opposite corners; the board is fixed down through them.

g.desc: Two M2.5 non-plated holes in opposite corners; the board is fixed down through them.

g.text: PG is open drain and pulled up to +3V3 through 100k (datasheet 8.3.5: pull up through a resistor; PG tolerates 20 V).

g.desc: PG is open drain and pulled up to +3V3 through 100k (datasheet 8.3.5: pull up through a resistor; PG tolerates 20 V).

g.text: F1 resettable PTC: Ihold 1.1 A, Vmax 33 V.

g.desc: F1 resettable PTC: Ihold 1.1 A, Vmax 33 V.

g.text: PG goes low during start-up and on a fault, so J2 pin 3 reads valid only after the 4 ms start-up delay.

g.desc: PG goes low during start-up and on a fault, so J2 pin 3 reads valid only after the 4 ms start-up delay.

g.text: D4 green fault LED from +3V3 through R_PGLED to PG: it is lit while PG is low, dark while power is good.

g.desc: D4 green fault LED from +3V3 through R_PGLED to PG: it is lit while PG is low, dark while power is good.

g.text: About 2.5 mA when lit (470 R, Vf about 2.1 V); U1's PG pull-down is about 92 ohm RDSON, so PG stays near 0.4 V.

g.desc: About 2.5 mA when lit (470 R, Vf about 2.1 V); U1's PG pull-down is about 92 ohm RDSON, so PG stays near 0.4 V.

g.text: D3 green power LED from the 3.3 V rail.

g.desc: D3 green power LED from the 3.3 V rail.

g.text: D1 Schottky in series blocks reverse polarity.

g.desc: D1 Schottky in series blocks reverse polarity.

g.text: C7 56 pF feed-forward across the upper resistor (datasheet Eq 9 gives about 60 pF).

g.desc: C7 56 pF feed-forward across the upper resistor (datasheet Eq 9 gives about 60 pF).

g.text: J2 pin 1 is +3.3 V, pin 2 GND, pin 3 power-good (3.3 V logic, 100k pull-up), pin 4 GND.

g.desc: J2 pin 1 is +3.3 V, pin 2 GND, pin 3 power-good (3.3 V logic, 100k pull-up), pin 4 GND.
